about: The native tab bar's hidden state (contract 3.4, 7.1, 10.3; D42, 11-shell.md G25), written by hand. RootTabControllerTests (FPUITests, read through #filePath) puts a live tab root in every row's state and checks the bar; the page's mock (tests/lib/harness.js) is held to the same rows once it reads this file on next.

selected = the selected tab (contract 1.2's ids). coach = the Coach tab's mode (contract 1.4): waiting, native or web. sheets = the page's last sheets state (contract 3.4: at least one overlay that covers the page's own #tabs in classic mode is open; reset to false at every document start). fellBack = the scene's tab root fell back (contract 10.3): the bar is hidden for good and the Coach tab is web for the rest of the scene, so only web rows exist there.

hidden = the bar is hidden (UITabBarController.isTabBarHidden). On a live root: hidden exactly when sheets is true and the selected tab is not a waiting or native Coach tab (an overlay in the hidden web view covers nothing, so a native Coach tab keeps its bar). After the fallback: always hidden.

The numbers follow the state: h (contract 7.1) is 0 exactly when hidden, else the bar frame's cover of the web view's bottom edge (83 on every iPhone under the iOS 26+ glass bar, delta 14.1); safe is the window's bottom inset whatever the state.

How a change gets there is not in this table: a sheet opening hides the bar at once, the last one closing shows it with an animation of at most 0.25 s (none under Reduce Motion), a selection or the fallback changes it without animation (RootTabControllerTests 6 and 8).
